blocks.text: Produced by Josh himself, the bold new single examines identity, adaptation, and what it means to remain one of one. Josh Cullen returns to his solo era with “Like Me,” his collab single with multi-awarded Korean-American rapper Jay Park under Sony Music Entertainment. Produced by Josh Cullen himself and co-written with Mathew Auditor and Jay Park, “Like Me” reflects on a world increasingly shaped by imitation, adaptation, and algorithmic influence, where originality can easily be diluted by the pressure to follow familiar formulas.
